meta.name: severity_scoring
meta.title: Bug severity scoring
meta.description: Bug reports from a fictional SaaS, e-commerce and mobile product family, scored on a four-level severity rubric by user impact rather than the reporter's tone.

severity.instructions: How severe is the problem described in `report`, judged by its impact on users rather than the reporter's tone?
criteria: cosmetic: a visual or wording issue with no effect on what users can do
minor: a feature misbehaves but users have an easy workaround
major: a core feature is broken for some or all users with no reasonable workaround
critical: data loss or corruption, a security or privacy breach, or the whole product unavailable

tags.easy: Straightforward: tone, topic and impact all point to the same level
tags.hard: Needs care: tone, topic words or a stated workaround point away from the correct level
tags.loud_but_minor: Reporter is angry or shouting but the impact is only cosmetic or minor
tags.calm_but_critical: Polite or understated report of data loss, a security/privacy breach or a full outage
tags.workaround_stated: The report mentions a workaround (easy or not)
tags.security: Topic: authentication, access control, credentials or privacy
tags.data_loss: Topic: data deleted, lost or corrupted
tags.outage: Topic: the product or a platform is unavailable or won't load
tags.ui_text: Topic: wording, labels, typos or copy
tags.boundary: Sits near a level boundary; the rationale explains which rubric rule decides it

input.report: Tallyo Shop search returns nothing if you leave a trailing space after the product name. Delete the space and results appear.

rationale: Search misbehaves in an edge case with an easy workaround.

input.report: Contacts edited on mobile are being saved with other contacts' phone numbers. Customers have already called the wrong people.

rationale: Records are being corrupted: critical.

input.report: Hey, not sure if this is expected, but when I edit a note on my phone while offline and it syncs later, the note on my laptop gets replaced by an empty one and the original text is gone. It's happened a few times now. Thanks!

rationale: Polite and hesitant, but notes are being wiped on sync, which is data loss: critical.

input.report: Address autocomplete at checkout doesn't suggest anything for addresses in Ireland. Customers can still type every field manually and the order goes through.

rationale: Checkout is a core flow, but it still completes and typing the address is an easy workaround, so only the autocomplete feature misbehaves: minor.

input.report: The admin panel at /admin loads without any login — anyone can view and edit every customer account.

rationale: Unauthenticated access to all accounts is a security breach: critical.

input.report: Drag-and-drop reordering of checklist items doesn't work in Firefox. The up/down arrows next to each item still reorder them.

rationale: Drag-and-drop is broken but the arrow buttons are an easy workaround.

input.report: Using bulk 'Move to folder' wipes the version history of every file that's moved — only the latest version survives. Workaround for now: download any older versions you need before moving files.

rationale: A workaround is stated, but confirmed data loss is critical regardless of how it can be avoided.

input.report: fyi prod s3 bucket with user uploads is public-read. found it through a google search.

rationale: Terse and unexcited, but users' uploaded files are publicly exposed, a privacy breach: critical.

input.report: 'Mark all as read' in notifications only marks the first 20. Pressing it again marks the next 20.

rationale: The button misbehaves but repeating it is an easy workaround.

input.report: prod: managers get 403 when clicking Approve on timesheets. all orgs. no admin override. payroll cutoff thu.

rationale: Terse, but it describes a core feature broken for all users with no workaround: major.

input.report: The CSV export of the invoice list is missing the 'Notes' column. The XLSX export includes notes, so that works if you need them.

rationale: The CSV export misbehaves, but the XLSX export is an easy alternative.

input.report: Saving a draft of a blog post overwrites the live published version, and the previous published content can't be recovered.

rationale: Published content is irrecoverably lost: critical.

input.report: WHO APPROVED THIS?!? The new font in the invoice PDF header is HIDEOUS. My clients are going to laugh at me. All the numbers and details are right, it's just UGLY. Change it back TODAY.

rationale: The reporter confirms the invoice content is correct; a disliked font is a purely visual issue.

input.report: Files over 10MB attached to projects fail silently and are never saved. Most of our clients' design files are 20–50MB and there's no other way to share them inside Tallyo.

rationale: A core feature is broken for some users with no reasonable workaround.

input.report: Profile photo upload rejects .HEIC files from iPhones. Converting the photo to JPG first and uploading that works.

rationale: An unsupported format with a simple conversion workaround is minor.

input.report: Customers with an apostrophe in their surname (e.g. O'Brien) get a 500 error every time they try to save their profile. There's no other way to update profile details.

rationale: A core feature is broken for some users with no workaround.

input.report: SMS two-factor codes are arriving 20–30 minutes late for users in India, by which time they've expired. Those users can't log in. Authenticator-app users are fine, but SMS users can't switch methods without logging in first.

rationale: An authentication topic but no breach: some users are locked out of the product with no workaround, which is major.

input.report: Checkout fails for every card payment with 'Payment could not be processed'. Cards are the only payment method our store offers, so nobody can buy anything, though browsing the catalogue works.

rationale: Purchasing is a core feature broken for all users, but the store is still up, so it is major rather than critical.

input.report: After the 4.2 update the Stridely app can't connect to any Bluetooth heart-rate strap or tracker, so workouts aren't recorded for anyone who uses one.

rationale: A core feature is broken for a group of users with no workaround.

input.report: Hi, sorry to bother you! Since yesterday's update the 'Add to cart' button on Tallyo Shop product pages doesn't do anything when I click it. I've tried two browsers and my phone. Thanks so much for any help :)

rationale: The polite tone is low-key, but adding to cart is a core shopping feature broken across devices with no workaround: major.

input.report: Empty-state text on the Tasks list says 'You have no task yet' — should be 'tasks'.

rationale: A grammar slip in an empty-state message is cosmetic.

input.report: ARE YOU KIDDING ME. I can't export ANY of my reports to PDF or CSV — both buttons just throw an error. My accountant needs these by Friday and there is no other way to get the data out!!!

rationale: The reporter is loud, and the impact is genuinely major: exports are broken with no workaround.

input.report: Hover colour on secondary buttons in Settings is #3B82F6 but the design system says #2563EB.

rationale: A colour mismatch with the design spec is cosmetic.

input.report: Dear Stridely team, I hope this message finds you well. I've been using the app every morning for three years and it's genuinely part of my routine, so thank you. I wanted to share a small piece of feedback. Since updating yesterday, all of my workout history from before 2024 no longer appears, and my yearly totals have dropped accordingly. I reinstalled, and your support team confirmed the records were removed during a migration. Anyway, keep up the great work!

rationale: Buried in a friendly email is confirmed loss of years of user data, which is critical.

input.report: Since this morning's deploy nobody can submit expense reports. The Submit button spins forever on web and in the mobile app. Everything else in Tallyo — invoices, projects, time tracking — works normally.

rationale: It feels like an outage, but only one core feature is broken while the rest of the product works, so it is major rather than critical.

input.report: The 'New' badge on the Integrations tab has been showing for eight months. Not really new anymore.

rationale: A stale badge is a visual/wording issue only.

input.report: Pasting an image into a task comment does nothing in Edge. Using the paperclip button to attach the same image works.

rationale: Paste is broken but the attach button is an easy workaround.

input.report: SSO login through Okta fails with 'invalid assertion' for all enterprise customers. Those workspaces enforce SSO, so password login isn't available to them.

rationale: Some users can't log in at all, but there is no breach and the product works for everyone else, so major rather than critical.

input.report: The copy button next to the API key doesn't copy anything in Safari. Selecting the key text and pressing Cmd+C works.

rationale: A broken copy button with manual copy as an easy workaround is minor.

input.report: Search returns zero results for every query in every workspace since 3am. Teams with hundreds of documents can't find anything.

rationale: Search is a core feature broken for all users with no workaround.

input.report: The final 'Book appointment' step in Tallyo Book errors out for every clinic that uses a custom domain. Their patients can't book online.

rationale: Booking is a core feature broken for some customers with no workaround.

input.report: Clicking 'Archive' on a project permanently deletes it and all its tasks instead of archiving it. There's no way to restore them.

rationale: Irrecoverable deletion is data loss: critical.

input.report: The 'Remember me' checkbox on the login page has no effect — I get logged out every day and have to sign in again.

rationale: Persistent login misbehaves, but signing in again is an easy workaround and nothing is blocked.

input.report: app.tallyo.com, the mobile apps and the public API all return 503 for every user since 10:42 UTC.

rationale: The whole product is unavailable for everyone.

input.report: Bulk delete in the Contacts list deletes every contact in the account, not just the selected ones.

rationale: Unintended mass deletion is data loss: critical.

input.report: After saving a contact, the confirmation toast says 'Contact deleted'. The contact is actually saved with all my edits and shows up in the list fine.

rationale: Alarming wording, but the save works and users lose no ability, so under the rubric it is a wording issue (cosmetic), not a misbehaving feature.

input.report: On Safari for iPhone, the 'Confirm order' button on the last checkout step renders off the bottom of the screen and the page won't scroll to it. Those customers can't place orders.

rationale: Looks like a layout glitch, but it blocks checkout for some users with no workaround, so it is major rather than cosmetic.

input.report: Escalating per customer request. She is extremely upset (her words: 'worst company ever, I'm telling everyone I know') because the tracking page says 'Your parcel is on it's way' with the wrong apostrophe. The tracking info itself is accurate. She wants a public apology.

rationale: The customer's anger aside, a misplaced apostrophe on an accurate tracking page is cosmetic.

input.report: Morning all, just flagging that the app won't load for any of us — blank white page. I asked friends at two other companies who use Tallyo and they get the same thing, and your status page won't load either. Cheers.

rationale: The casual tone hides a full outage across customers, which is critical.

input.report: Customer is threatening a chargeback and posting on Twitter because the coupon field rejects lowercase codes. Typing SAVE10 in capitals works — I told him, he says that's not his job.

rationale: The customer's escalation doesn't change impact: the coupon works when typed in capitals, an easy workaround, so minor.

input.report: Primary database is down. Every request to the web app and the mobile API returns 500. Nothing works for anyone.

rationale: The whole product is unavailable for everyone.

input.report: Two-factor login accepts any 6-digit code after the third failed attempt, so anyone who knows a user's password can get into their account.

rationale: Bypassable authentication exposes accounts to takeover, a security breach: critical.

input.report: On the Orders list, the 'Next' arrow is disabled on page 2 even though there are five pages. Clicking the page number '3' directly works.

rationale: Pagination misbehaves but the page-number links are an easy workaround.

input.report: MY ENTIRE INVOICE HISTORY IS GONE!!! Four years of invoices — the list is empty and search finds nothing. Your support agent confirmed they were deleted on your side.

rationale: Here the loud tone matches the impact: confirmed data loss is critical.

input.report: The public invoice share link doesn't check its token. Changing the invoice number in the URL shows any customer's invoice, including their name and address.

rationale: Exposing other customers' data is a privacy breach: critical.

input.report: To whom it may concern. I have been a loyal Pocketly customer for SIX YEARS and I have never been so insulted. Since your latest so-called 'update' the app logs me out whenever I switch to another app for more than a minute. Yes, I can log straight back in with Face ID, but that is not the point. It is the principle. I expect a personal reply from someone senior.

rationale: The tone is outraged, but an over-eager logout with instant Face ID re-login is a misbehaving feature with an easy workaround: minor.

input.report: Shipping notification email subject has a double space: 'Your order  has shipped'.

rationale: Extra whitespace in a subject line is a wording issue.

input.report: The /v2/users API endpoint returns the email addresses and password hashes of every user in the system to any logged-in account.

rationale: Leaking other users' credentials is a security breach: critical.

input.report: Hi team, hope you're all well! I was showing Pocketly to my dad over the weekend and he's very particular about these things. He noticed that the little piggy-bank illustration on the empty Savings Goals screen has five legs. I honestly think this is a serious bug and it made the app look a bit amateurish to him. Everything else worked perfectly when we set up his first goal. Love the app otherwise, keep it up!

rationale: The reporter calls it serious, but an odd illustration on a screen that works perfectly is cosmetic.

input.report: The upload progress bar jumps from about 40% straight to 100% instead of filling smoothly. Uploads complete and the files open fine afterwards.

rationale: Close to a misbehaving feature, but the upload itself works; only the progress animation is off, so it is cosmetic.

input.report: Cookie banner text says 'We use cookies to improve you experience'.

rationale: A typo in banner copy is cosmetic.

input.report: Password reset emails aren't being sent at all. Users who forgot their password are locked out, and support has no way to reset passwords manually.

rationale: Account recovery is broken with no workaround, but nothing is breached or lost: major.

input.report: Dashboard KPI cards have uneven gaps between them at 1366px screen width.

rationale: Uneven spacing is a layout issue with no functional effect.

input.report: Hi, small thing — when I logged in this morning my dashboard showed someone else's name and their invoices. Probably a caching thing? No rush, just letting you know.

rationale: Understated, but seeing another customer's data is a privacy breach, which is critical.

input.report: Everything is so slow it's effectively down: every page times out after two minutes for every customer, and the mobile app can't load anything.

rationale: Framed as slowness, but the whole product is unusable for everyone, which is an outage and critical.

input.report: Login fails with 'Unexpected error' for every user on web, iOS and Android. All existing sessions expired overnight, so nobody can get into the product at all.

rationale: A login bug might sound like one broken feature, but it leaves the whole product unavailable for everyone, so critical.

input.report: Since the pricing change, the 'Add task' button is greyed out for all users on the Free plan.

rationale: Creating tasks is core and is broken for a group of users with no workaround.

input.report: Android 15: the loading spinner on the Pocketly splash screen is about 10px off-centre. The app opens normally after it.

rationale: An off-centre spinner on a screen that proceeds normally is cosmetic.

input.report: Invite links in workspace invitation emails return a 404, so no new users can join any workspace.

rationale: Onboarding new users is broken for everyone with no workaround.

input.report: On the Tallyo iPad app in landscape, long project titles on the board are cut off with an ellipsis after about 30 characters. Tapping the card opens the project with its full title, same as always.

rationale: Near minor, but nothing misbehaves functionally: truncation is display-only and users can do everything as before, so it is cosmetic.

input.report: Recurring invoices haven't been generated since the 1st. You can create each invoice by hand, but our larger customers bill 300+ clients a month.

rationale: Recreating hundreds of invoices manually is not an easy workaround, so the broken core feature is major, not minor.

input.report: URGENT P0!!! CEO noticed the login page background image is pixelated on his 5K monitor. DROP EVERYTHING. Login itself works fine.

rationale: Priority labels and urgency don't change impact: a pixelated background on a working login page is cosmetic.

input.report: The Pocketly app crashes immediately on launch for everyone on iOS 17. iOS 18 and Android users are fine.

rationale: The app is unavailable for one group of users only; the whole product being down for everyone is what makes critical, so this is major.

input.report: Since Tuesday's release the Reports page takes 6–8 seconds to load (used to be about 2). It does load and the numbers are correct.

rationale: Slower but usable performance is minor under the rubric.

input.report: Scrolling in long chat threads in the mobile app stutters a bit on older Android phones, but it's usable.

rationale: Usable but sluggish performance is minor.

input.report: The 'Sort by date' option in the Files view ignores the first click. Clicking it a second time sorts correctly.

rationale: Sorting misbehaves but clicking again is an easy workaround.

input.report: Minor observation from regression testing: after logging out on a shared computer and pressing Back, the previous user's account page appears with their full card details, and the buttons on it still work.

rationale: Labelled minor, but another user's session and card details remain accessible after logout, a security breach: critical.

input.report: Generating the monthly revenue report now times out after 60 seconds for any workspace with more than about 500 invoices, so those customers can't get the report at all.

rationale: A performance problem, but it makes a core flow unusable for some users rather than merely slow, which the rubric puts at major.

input.report: This is a JOKE. The dashboard takes like 5 seconds to load now. FIVE SECONDS. I'm paying for Premium. Absolutely ridiculous, I'm looking at your competitors.

rationale: A five-second load is slow but usable, which the rubric treats as minor regardless of tone.

input.report: The browser tab favicon still shows the old logo.

rationale: An outdated favicon has no effect on what users can do.

input.report: THIS IS UNACCEPTABLE. Your welcome banner literally says 'Welcome back, {first_name}!' instead of my name. I pay for this product and you can't even get my NAME right?? Fix it NOW.

rationale: Despite the anger, an unfilled placeholder in a greeting is a wording issue with no effect on what the user can do.

input.report: Filter chips on the Tasks board reset whenever you switch to Calendar view and back, so you have to re-apply them.

rationale: Lost filter state is a misbehaving feature with an easy workaround (re-applying).

input.report: Invoice PDF downloads come out blank for all users. The only workaround we've found is support manually regenerating each PDF from the admin console and emailing it, which takes about 10 minutes per invoice.

rationale: A workaround is mentioned, but it isn't something users can do themselves easily, so it doesn't count as an easy workaround: major.

input.report: Ctrl+Z in the rich text editor undoes typing but not formatting changes. You can toggle the formatting back off from the toolbar.

rationale: Undo misbehaves for formatting but the toolbar is an easy workaround.

input.report: The footer copyright on the marketing site and in the app still says '© 2025'.

rationale: An outdated copyright year is a wording issue with no effect on users.

input.report: Settings > Privacy shows the heading 'Privacy Settings' twice, one directly under the other.

rationale: A duplicated heading is a visual/wording issue.

input.report: Bulk-editing tags on more than 50 tasks at once fails with 'Request too large'. Selecting 50 or fewer at a time and repeating works.

rationale: A limit on a bulk action could look major, but batching in groups of 50 is an easy workaround, so it is minor.

input.report: The Ctrl+K search shortcut does nothing in Chrome on Linux. Clicking the search icon in the top bar works fine.

rationale: A broken shortcut with an equivalent button is minor.

input.report: Typo on the Billing settings page: the toggle label says 'Recieve invoices by email'. Should be 'Receive'.

rationale: A spelling mistake in a label changes nothing users can do, so it is cosmetic.

input.report: The order confirmation email's logo appears horizontally stretched in Outlook desktop. Order details in the email are correct.

rationale: A distorted logo in an otherwise correct email is visual only.

input.report: Transfers to other banks fail with error E-401 for all Pocketly users since this morning. Transfers between your own Pocketly accounts still work.

rationale: External transfers are a core banking feature broken for all users; internal transfers are not a substitute.

input.report: Product thumbnails in the Tallyo Shop grid have inconsistent corner radius — some are rounded, some square.

rationale: Inconsistent styling of images is purely visual.

input.report: Since the CDN change the checkout page takes 45+ seconds and then times out for about a third of customers.

rationale: Checkout times out for some users, making a core flow unusable: major.

input.report: After the 3.4 migration, every attachment uploaded before March is gone from every project. The files show 'not found' and support confirmed they weren't migrated.

rationale: Confirmed data loss is critical.

input.report: Editing the shipping address on one order in the Shop admin also overwrites the shipping address on all of that customer's other open orders, and the old addresses aren't kept anywhere.

rationale: It looks like a misbehaving edit feature, but it silently corrupts other records, which the rubric places at critical.

input.report: I HAVE HAD IT WITH YOUR APP. Every time I open it on my phone it forgets I picked dark mode and I have to switch it back on in Settings. EVERY. SINGLE. TIME. Do you people even test anything???

rationale: Shouting aside, a preference that doesn't persist is a misbehaving feature with an easy workaround (re-toggling), so minor.

input.report: Full customer credit card numbers are being written in plain text to the application logs, which the whole support team can read.

rationale: Exposing card data to staff who shouldn't see it is a privacy breach: critical.

input.report: Pocketly is completely down — app and website both show 'Service unavailable' at login for every customer.

rationale: The whole product is unavailable for everyone.

input.report: On Firefox the 'Export' button on the Reports page sits about 4px lower than the buttons next to it. Clicking it exports normally.

rationale: A misaligned button that still works is a purely visual issue.

input.report: FYI, I just received an email with a support chat transcript that isn't mine — it's someone else's conversation, including their order number and home address. Just thought you'd want to know.

rationale: Casually reported, but other customers' personal data is being sent to the wrong people, a privacy breach: critical.

input.report: I am FURIOUS. Your checkout page shows the delivery-truck icon in blue instead of your brand green. It looks cheap and unprofessional and my customers will think it's a scam site!!! Escalate this immediately.

rationale: An off-brand icon colour on a working checkout is cosmetic; the reporter's fury doesn't change the impact.

input.report: Opening the Orders page for stores with more than 10k orders just spins until the browser shows 'Page unresponsive'. Those merchants can't view or fulfil any orders.

rationale: Not just slow: a core flow is unusable for some users, which the rubric treats as major.

input.report: Tab order on the signup form skips the 'Company' field. You can still click into it and fill it in.

rationale: Broken keyboard order with clicking as an easy workaround is minor.

input.report: Spanish locale: the save button on the profile page reads 'Guardar cambios cambios' (word repeated). Saving works.

rationale: A duplicated word in a working button label is a wording issue.

input.report: Team member avatars on the People page look slightly blurry on retina screens.

rationale: Low-resolution images are a visual issue with no functional effect.

input.report: Push notifications for new comments arrive on time, but tapping one opens the app's home screen instead of the comment. The comment is one tap away in the Activity tab.

rationale: The deep link is broken, but the comment is reachable with one extra tap, which is an easy workaround, so minor rather than major.

input.report: Help Center search takes around 10 seconds to show results for long queries. Short queries are instant and results are correct either way.

rationale: Noticeably slow but it completes and remains usable, which the rubric places at minor, not major.

input.report: Tapping 'Scan receipt' opens a black camera screen on every Android 14 device we've tried. There's no other way to attach a receipt in the mobile app.

rationale: A core feature is broken for a group of users with no workaround.

input.report: When setting up two-factor authentication in dark mode on Android, the QR code renders as a black square. The 'Enter key manually' link below it works and 2FA gets set up fine.

rationale: A security feature is involved but nothing is breached; the QR display misbehaves with an easy manual-key workaround, so minor.

input.report: Posting a comment on any task returns 'Something went wrong' and the comment isn't saved. Nobody can comment.

rationale: Commenting is a core collaboration feature broken for all users with no workaround.
